summary.text: Harlan Vincent is a Republican state representative from New Mexico who has represented House District 56 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked as a firefighter and emergency medical technician with Lincoln County.

paragraphs.text: Vincent was born in Clovis, New Mexico, and lives in Lincoln County.
He is a member of the National Rifle Association.
